name: Clarity of Thought
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You call upon the stillness of the universe to grant you mental and emotional peace. You gain a +4 insight bonus to Concentration checks.
